title: Limit theorems for differential systems with multipoint boundary conditions in Sobolev spaces
summary: The most general class of multipoint inhomogeneous boundary-value problems for systems of linear ordinary differential equations of arbitrary order $r\geq 1$ is investigated, whose solutions belong to a given Sobolev space $W_p^{n+r}$, where $n\geq 0$ and $1\leq p\leq \infty$. The boundary conditions in these problems contain Caputo derivatives of fractional or integer orders, which may exceed the order of the differential system equations.
